name: TRÅDFRI
description: Legacy IKEA gateway lights, groups and lighting controls

settings.label: Gateway address
settings.help: Private IPv4 address of the original TRÅDFRI gateway. DIRIGERA is not supported.

settings.label: Gateway security code
settings.help: Optional replacement: the code printed on this gateway. A refresh derives a Windows-protected identity/PSK. Clear after success; a nonempty setting remains private plaintext.

settings.label: Fade duration (seconds)
settings.help: Default brightness, white temperature and colour fade. Stored scenes can override it under Scenes - Transition. 0-60 seconds, rounded to 0.1 second; 0 means immediate. Simple on/off commands do not fade.

actions.name: Refresh lights and groups
actions.description: Read this legacy gateway without changing lights.

actions.name: Reauthenticate gateway
actions.description: Authenticate with the configured printed gateway code and protect the resulting credentials.

actions.name: Set light power
actions.description: Send one explicit lighting command; subsequent readings confirm actual state.

actions.name: Set light brightness
actions.description: Send one explicit lighting command; subsequent readings confirm actual state.

actions.name: Set light white temperature
actions.description: Send one explicit lighting command; subsequent readings confirm actual state.

actions.name: Set light color
actions.description: Send one explicit lighting command; subsequent readings confirm actual state.

actions.name: Set group power
actions.description: Send one explicit lighting command; subsequent readings confirm actual state.

actions.name: Set group brightness
actions.description: Send one explicit lighting command; subsequent readings confirm actual state.

actions.name: Restore light state
actions.description: Restore captured power, brightness and supported colour settings together in one light command.

actions.name: Run lighting scene
actions.description: Run an enabled scene saved on the TRÅDFRI lighting remote, then continue with the next Task step.

parameters.label: Lighting scene
parameters.help: Save and enable scenes under Controls → TRÅDFRI → Scenes. The Controls page must also be enabled.

actions.name: Rename gateway device
actions.description: Update a reported device name using a current editor token.

actions.name: Edit gateway room
actions.description: Update one existing room name and its light membership using a current editor token.

actions.name: Read gateway scenes
actions.description: Read a room scene list or one stored light-only scene without activating it. Use Scenes - Import from gateway.

events.name: Lights updated
events.description: A committed gateway reading; typed Task rules retain true-edge behavior.

events.name: Light changed
events.description: An observed reported-light change, claimed before dispatch; first readings establish baselines.
